Commentary.Commentary: Afghanistan kept on losing wickets right from the start. They failed to stick a promising stand. Nasir Jamal and Afsar Zazai batted well in the middle but not for long. Credit to the home team. They started with the seamers and once bot the spinners came in, it was light work for them. So, Bangladesh lead by 236 runs. They will look to bat till the end of the session and take full control of this game. Stay tuned.

That was quick from Bangladesh and they are right on top of this game. They are not enforcing the follow-on. Afghanistan have not even batted two full sessions and have to do it all over again against the Bangladeshi bowlers who are spot on. Consistency is key for the Bangladesh bowlers who are bowling in good areas and are getting their rewards.

OUT! STUMPED! Tossed up, outside off. Janat skips down and tries to find the gap on the leg side but plays inside the line of the ball. It goes past the outside edge and to the keeper who makes no mistake. AFGHANISTAN BOWLED OUT FOR  146.

...Day 2, Session 3...

Another session which belongs to the hosts! Afghanistan are still around 40 runs away from avoiding the follow-on and they just have the two wickets in hand. The session started off nicely for them, Nasir Jamal and Afsar Zazai scored freely but once that partnership was broken, wickets yet again fell quickly. Karim Janat is the only recognized batter left and Afghanistan will hope, he along with the tail can avoid the follow-on. Bangladesh on the other hand, would like to take the remaining two wickets quickly. An interesting session awaits.
On middle, blocked. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 2!

Commentary.Commentary: Top, top show from the hosts with the ball. After losing their last five for not a lot earlier on, their bowlers have roared back and got three in no time. Afghanistan are in deep trouble as they have lost their top three. The Bangladesh pacers have been brilliant so far for them making excellent use of the conditions. More of the same is what they'll want after the break. Afghanistan on the other hand will hope for a partnership. Can they fight back? We will find out.
